sources_used: pinballmap.com / pinside.com / findapinball.com (Megarex, Player's Bar, West-Bowling)
for-amusement-only.de / FAO YouTube Beat Mania 3rd Mix

findings.name: Megarex
findings.evidence_quote: piu and guitar hero where removed for a "dance battle" (i wont bother adding this shit) dont go there if you expect rhythm games but do check it out if you like pinballs they have a massive collection of modern stern LE
findings.note: May 2026 ZIv: Pump It Up Phoenix and Guitar Hero removed. Venue is major pinball destination (Pinball Map / Pinside list dozens of Stern tables). Dance battle cab not a catalog rhythm slug. Historical DDR/PIU gone.

findings.name: Méga CGR
findings.evidence_quote: DDRX no longer present
findings.note: Épinay-sur-Seine CGR. DDR X removed per 2017 ZIv comment. Instagram cgr_epinay mentions new arcade games in lobby (not named). No current Bemani/SEGA rhythm evidence. Open cinema, empty ZIv list.

findings.name: Méga CGR
findings.evidence_quote: No games at this location.
findings.note: Evry CGR. ZIv empty games list. No web hits for DDR/maimai/PIU at this branch. Cinema arcade only, not proven none.

findings.name: Pathé Quai d'Ivry
findings.evidence_quote: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX; Overtake DX; Sega Rally 3; Super Bikes 3; Jurassic Park Arcade; Lost Land Adventure; Razing Storm; Space Invaders Frenzy; Star Wars Battle Pod; The Walking Dead; Tomb Raider DX; ... Flippers Game of Thrones Pro; Pince à peluches
findings.note: Annuaire-Arcade full list is racing, rail shooters, motion sim, kids, pinball, claw. No DDR/PIU/maimai/etc. ZIv 2021: DDR X removed. Pathé site still advertises arcade space. Confidence likely (directory not dated).

findings.name: Player's Bar
findings.evidence_quote: Play pinball at Player's Bar (Riom, France). Pinball: Last Action Hero (Data East 1993). Freshness: Last update on August 21, 2024
findings.note: Pinball bar (findapinball). ZIv empty music list. No evidence of catalog rhythm cabinets. Venue type is pinball/bar, not rhythm arcade.

findings.name: SpeedPark Conflans
findings.evidence_quote: Karting, bowling, laser tag, virtual reality or arcade games: enjoy a wide choice of activities... arcade machines
findings.note: Indoor leisure complex with arcade area. Official site does not name any music/rhythm titles. ZIv empty. Family FEC-style unknown inventory.

findings.name: Toto loisirs
findings.evidence_quote: No games at this location.
findings.note: Seaside amusement (Toto Jeux et Loisirs Le Pouliguen). ZIv stub only. No rhythm evidence found; not positive none.

findings.name: VR Station
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Beat Saber Arcade (North America)
findings.note: Beat Saber Arcade is VR rhythm, not a named catalog slug. Mapped to other. No maimai/DDR/etc. found.

findings.name: Action Arena Norderstedt
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Dance Central 3 (International). Also Pac-Man, Dirty Drivin', Storm Racer G, Super Bikes, Deadstorm Pirates, Terminator Salvation, Mario & Sonic Rio, Street Basketball
findings.note: Dance Central 3 is Kinect dance, not a valid catalog slug. Mapped to other. No Bemani/SEGA performai.

findings.name: Action Arena Schwentinental
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: E5 Dance Super Station (China). Also Pac-Man, Batman, GRID, Storm Racer G, Super Bikes, Fantasy Soccer, Pong Knock Out
findings.note: E5 Dance Super Station generic Chinese dance pad. Mapped to other. No catalog Bemani/SEGA titles.

findings.name: Cinedom Köln
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Dirty Drivin'; NASCAR Team Racing; Super Bikes; Super Bikes (2P); Star Wars Trilogy Arcade. Comment ~6 months ago: I couldn't find any games at all.
findings.note: Historical ZIv lineup is racing/rail only (no music games). Recent visitor could not find any cabs. No catalog rhythm games ever listed.

findings.name: Exus Gamezone Neufahrn
findings.evidence_quote: Part of the 3D Neongolf and 3D Pit-Pat amusement center. Games: Super Bikes 3; Super Bikes 3
findings.note: ZIv only lists Super Bikes 3 (2 units). Mini-golf / pit-pat leisure center, no music games listed.

findings.name: For Amusement Only
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: beatmania 3rdMIX (Japan) Location: Second row from the back, on the very right Comment: English translated Beatmania 3rdMIX minicab
findings.note: Classic beatmania 3rdMIX (not IIDX). Mapped to other. ZIv last game update 2018; FAO YouTube still hosts Beat Mania 3rd Mix cab video. Museum open first Saturday monthly (flipperundarcade). Presence of cab after 2018 not re-verified.

findings.name: Galaxy Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Independent arcade in the center of Bad Kreuznach. Opened October 2024. Games: Ice Cold Beer; Guardians of the Galaxy (pinball); Boxing Machine; To Tha Net. Also unknown airhockey, bumper table, Let's Goal soccer.
findings.note: Small independent arcade: pinball, novelty, sports. Full ZIv inventory has no music/rhythm cabinets.

findings.name: Jump House
findings.evidence_quote: Indoor tumbling center with a field of trampolines... They have a few arcade games at the entrance: 2x Ultra Race; Crazy Hoop; Football Kickbox machine; Duo Driver Racing game; Air Hockey machine
findings.note: Trampoline park entrance arcades only (racing/sports/air hockey). Explicit full list, no rhythm.

findings.name: Motorworld München
findings.evidence_quote: A car exhibition with some pinballs and a SEGA F355 Challenge. Games: Ferarri F355 Challenge: Ferrari Theater (1st Floor)
findings.note: Car museum attraction. Only Ferrari F355 Challenge racing sim + pinball noted. No rhythm games.

findings.name: Pelotero Fun-City Indoor-und Outdoor
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: OpenITG (International) €1.00 for 3 songs Great
findings.note: OpenITG is open-source ITG (DDR-style pad software), not official DDR or StepManiaX. Mapped to other. Not ddr/stepmaniax without official cabinet branding. Address coords look offset from Wesselburen (ZIv says Wesselburen 25764).

findings.name: Playland Cologne/Bonn Airport
findings.evidence_quote: Airport arcade in Cologne. Mostly gambling, but has a few genuine arcade machines. Games: OutRun 2; Sega Rally 3
findings.note: 2016 ZIv: only OutRun 2 and Sega Rally 3 among non-gambling cabs. No music games listed. Very old update; current floor may differ. Still no rhythm evidence.

findings.name: RetroGames e.V. Karlsruhe
findings.evidence_quote: Weekend arcade... Has all kinds of retro pinball and arcade machines... Games listed: Arkanoid, Centipede, Dig Dug, Frogger, Hyper Bishi Bashi Champ, Tron, Mortal Kombat, Tekken, Asteroids, Donkey Kong, Mario Kart Arcade GP 2, OutRun, Sega Rally, Area 51, Star Wars Battle Pod, Virtua Cop 2, etc. No Music Game section entries.
findings.note: Museum (~200 machines). ZIv partial list has no catalog rhythm titles. Collection is large and rotating; cannot prove absence of every music cab. Active 2026 (KAMUNA, summer pause notes on retrogames.info).

findings.name: Spielcafe Bonn
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Tekken 5 Version 5.1 (Not Working); Virtua Striker 4 ver. 2006. Updated 2013-09-07
findings.note: Now operates as Spielhalle/Spielcafe gambling venues (spielcafebonn.de, Maximilianstr. 28). ZIv music empty; only fighter/sports from 2013. No rhythm evidence; not proven none for current floor.

findings.name: Sportsbar 77
findings.evidence_quote: Sports bar with 4 pinball machines. Used to have a few privately owned arcade cabs, but they were removed late in 2015. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Arcades removed 2015; pinball-only sports bar since. No music games. 2016 note is explicit positive removal; no later re-add found.

findings.name: West-Bowling Köln
findings.evidence_quote: Arcade Spiele: 10 Arcade & 2 Darts Spiele ab 1€. Wir bieten eine breite Palette von Spielen... von klassischen Videospielen bis hin zu modernen virtuellen Realitäts-Spielen
findings.note: Bowling + billiard + 10 unnamed arcade cabs + darts + VR. Pinball Map lists Elvis + Medieval Madness. ZIv empty games; ~6mo comment machines unpowered during construction. Rhythm titles not named.

findings.name: Lemon Arcades
findings.evidence_quote: They have access to a dance central AC 3 cabinet. Music Game: Dance Central 3 (International) Perfect. Updated 2025-10-13
findings.note: Cape Coast, Ghana. Dance Central 3 only music cab noted (TikTok linked on ZIv). Mapped to other. No catalog Bemani/SEGA.

findings.name: Bianos Bowling
findings.evidence_quote: no idea what machines they have but they 100% have claw machines. No games at this location.
findings.note: Glyfada bowling. Claws confirmed; other floor unknown. Not positive none for rhythm.

findings.name: Cafe
findings.evidence_quote: No games at this location.
findings.note: Sidari Corfu generic Cafe stub on ZIv. No inventory, no web hits. Adjacent to Cafe Interactive which has dance/GH.

findings.name: Cafe Interactive
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: E5 Dance Super Station (China) near the entrance... Currently unplayable, will be fixed. Guitar Hero Arcade (International) near the entrance. Guitars work good
findings.note: Sidari. E5 dance pad + Guitar Hero Arcade. Both map to other (not catalog slugs). E5 was unplayable at report time.

findings.name: Cosmic Bowling
findings.evidence_quote: mostly claw machines. No games at this location.
findings.note: Giannouzi bowling. Mostly claws is soft, not hard proof of zero rhythm. No specific music cab found.

findings.name: Kiosk
findings.evidence_quote: this is not an arcade its a "periptero" but it has some machines (including pinball). Games: Whirl-Wind (pinball)
findings.note: Skala beach kiosk/periptero with pinball. Only Whirl-Wind listed. No rhythm machines.

findings.name: North West Bowling Preveza
findings.evidence_quote: random machines mostly claw machines. No games at this location.
findings.note: Preveza bowling. Mostly claws; rhythm not ruled out rigorously.

findings.name: PLAY HALL
findings.evidence_quote: i've never been there but there are many claw machines there (i've seen some pics). Tekken 5 Version 5.1 GUYS I'VE NEVER BEEN THERE I AM NOT SURE WHICH VERSION IT IS
findings.note: Ioannina. Unvisited second-hand report: claws + uncertain Tekken. No music games claimed; not solid confirmed_none.

findings.name: PLAYZONE
findings.evidence_quote: No games at this location.
findings.note: Patra ZIv stub. No inventory or web evidence for rhythm or absence.

findings.name: Planet Cocktail Bar
findings.evidence_quote: Seaside bar with a few arcade machines and toys (nothing retro). Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade. Racing: Super Bikes
findings.note: Corfu Ypsos. Guitar Hero Arcade maps to other. No catalog Bemani/SEGA rhythm.

findings.name: Royal Bowling
findings.evidence_quote: the machines there are mostly for small kids. No games at this location.
findings.note: Peristeri bowling. Kid machines only per note. Soft, not hard confirmed_none.

findings.name: SATGAMES
findings.evidence_quote: PLEASE READ!! this is NOT the specific location because this arcade cannot be found in google (maps) its an arcade with tickets, you can get stuff with them (even a ps5!)
findings.note: Iraklio ticket redemption arcade, geolocation uncertain per submitter. No machine list. Ambiguous venue.

findings.name: Ta Papagalakia
findings.evidence_quote: Really Creepy and the machines are BAD... full of bad claw machines and bad prizes... i found some ancient images of it and they used to have guitar hero (sadly they don't have it anymore i visited today)
findings.note: Agios Ioannis Rentis. On-site visit: GH gone, claw-only. Positive absence of former music cab.

findings.evidence_quote: a cinema with a small arcade (claw machines mostly). Games: Arctic (air hockey table; comment: i do not know which hockey table it is. but it is not Arctic)
findings.note: Volos Village Cinemas. Claws + air hockey only. No music games listed.

findings.note: Athens Pagkrati Village Cinemas. Former GH removed; now claws. No current rhythm.
